queries_run: Spotify market share music streaming 2026 gaining OR losing
Spotify new entrant OR competitor threat 2026 YouTube Music Apple Music subscribers

findings.claim: 20-F 風險因素：Apple、Alphabet、Amazon 的裝置預載或預設其自家音訊串流服務，Spotify 自述處於重大競爭劣勢；並提及 AI 帶來新進入者與新消費方式
findings.excerpt: Some of our competitors, including Apple, Alphabet, and Amazon, have developed, and are continuing to develop, devices for which their audio streaming services are preloaded or may also be set as the default providers, which puts us at a significant competitive disadvantage.

findings.claim: 20-F：新興技術（含 AI）使競爭者推出新的內容消費方式，可能使年輕用戶轉向其他產品，影響留存
findings.excerpt: Our current and future competitors have introduced, and may continue to introduce, new ways of consuming or engaging with content that cause our users, especially the younger demographic, to switch to another product or service, which would negatively affect our user retention, growth, and engagement.

findings.claim: Midia：Spotify 2025 年淨增訂閱數為各 DSP 最高；YouTube Music 在 MENA 成為第一，並在未來成長市場加速
Digital Music News：美國 YouTube Music 訂閱用戶一年增 45%
